name: Crocus Field
source:
It's been a year since beginning your life as a farmer in Stardew Valley, but in the doldrums of late winter you find yourself isolating and stagnating. Picking some tasks to do, you venture out into the forests, mountains, and town for resources. 

Along the way, you bump into your favorite people, and grow ever closer to them. Do you choose to hear their secrets as friends, or make a move on them as something more?

[From [url=https://zoeboe.itch.io/crocus-field]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自从你在星露谷开始农民生活已经一年了，但在冬末的低迷时期，你发现自己孤立无援、停滞不前。选择一些要做的任务，你就可以冒险进入森林、山脉和城镇寻找资源。

一路上，你会遇到你最喜欢的人，并与他们变得越来越近。你会选择以朋友的身份聆听他们的秘密，还是以更多的方式对他们采取行动？

[来自[url=https://zoeboe.itch.io/crocus-field]Itch.io[/url]]
